title: Public Realm Administrator
company: Babergh and Mid Suffolk District Council - Agency - Permanent
description:
Babergh and Mid Suffolk District Councils are looking for a Public Realm Administrator to join our team. You will join us on a part time, fixed term or secondment opportunity for 12 months, working 18.5 hours per week. The successful candidate will earn a competitive salary of £28,608 - £32,046 per annum pro rata.

Join our team

We are looking for an Administrator (Admin and Technical Support Officer) to join our Public Realm team.

If you share our values and you are motivated to make a difference for our residents, clients, and communities, we would love to hear from you.

About the role

This is predominantly a support role for the Operational Teams, answering queries as first point of contact, transferring or signposting the customer to colleagues or external sources where appropriate. This may be by telephone, e-mail or through our workflow software system.

You will also be raising requisitions via the finance system and progressing through to payments, speaking with suppliers and other teams when needed as well as other general administration duties.

About you

We are looking for a flexible team player who is organised and able to multi-task and work at pace.

Attention to detail will be key and there is a need for experience in using Microsoft Office including the ability to use Word, Outlook and Excel.

You will have good communication skills; both written and verbal.

About us

At Babergh and Mid Suffolk District Councils we are passionate about building communities that people want to live, work, visit and invest in.

We serve around 200,000 residents across our two districts and are well known for our collaboration and partnership working across public, private and voluntary sectors.

We believe that the heart of Suffolk is an incredibly special place to live and work, with:
- 60 conservation areas
- two National Landscapes
- many picturesque market towns

It is no surprise we are ranked among the top 50 places to live in the UK (United Kingdom).

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:
- Generous leave entitlement (26 days a year, rising to 31 days after 5 years).
- Competitive Local Government Pension Scheme.
- Wellbeing Support and Employee Assistance Programs.
- Private Health Care Options.
- Electric Vehicle Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
- Paid volunteering days.
- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements (Business needs permitting).
- Great learning and development opportunities.

Our ways of working

We believe work is what we do, not just where we go.

We work in a hybrid way, with a mix of office, home, and remote based working (Business need permitting). Our hybrid working arrangements support flexibility and collaboration, helping our teams to thrive.

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion, providing opportunity and ambition for all, supporting and enabling our people to deliver the best possible services for our residents.

Closing date: 5pm, 17 September 2026

If you think you have what it takes to be successful in this Public Ream Administrator role, even if you don t meet all the requirements, please apply. We would appreciate the opportunity to consider your application.

This authority is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. DBS checks or police vetting will be required for relevant posts.

title: Project Administrator
description:
Job Description

Liquidline is the fastest-growing commercial coffee solutions provider in the UK and Ireland-not that we're bragging! Our customers are companies that take pride in offering quality refreshments to their employees and clients. Our success is built on outstanding customer service, hard work, and a strong team culture. We believe in delivering WOW experiences to both our customers and our valued employees.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified, a testament to our dedication to fostering a culture of support, growth and development, as well as promoting well-being, and winning together. With our core company values-passion, thoughtfulness, responsiveness, innovation, and smart working-at the very heart of our business, we are committed to cultivating an environment that inspires excellence.

We are looking for a Project Administrator to provide comprehensive administrative, governance and coordination support to the ERP Programme Manager and wider project team. The role is responsible for ensuring effective project controls, accurate reporting, documentation management, meeting coordination, and maintenance of programme governance processes.

Following the completion of the ERP Programme, the role will transition into supporting multiple projects and change initiatives across the business, helping to ensure projects are delivered in a structured, organised and well-governed manner.

The Responsibilities of the Project Administrator
- Coordinate project meetings, including scheduling, preparing agendas, recording actions, and tracking progress.
- Maintain accurate and organised project documentation, templates, and records.
- Manage project tools and systems, ensuring tasks, workflows, and reporting are kept up to date.
- Monitor project action, risks, issues, and key decisions
- Support project planning by updating schedules, milestones, and progress reports.
- Assists with resource planning and team workload tracking
- Prepare project updates, reports, and dashboards for senior stakeholders.
- Support the development of project plans, requirements, and delivery schedules.
- Provide administrative and governance support across multiple projects and business change initiatives.
- Work closely with project managers, teams, and stakeholders to ensure effective project coordination and accurate reporting.

What You Will Need In The Role Of Project Administrator
- Strong administrative and organisational skills
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience preparing reports, presentations and business documents
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Experience with project coordination and task tracking
- Familiarity with project tools such as Asana, Jira or similar.
- Strong attention to detail and problem solving skills

What You Will Learn & What Liquidline Can Offer You

Being a part of Liquidline is more than just a job - it's a chance to grow, develop and thrive! We are deeply invested in the success of our team and our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support, and reward our employees. The package includes, but is not limited too:
- 25 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays: Extra time off to rest and recharge.
- Long Service Annual Leave Entitlement & Buy/Sell Scheme: More flexibility for your time off needs.
- Candidate Referral Program: Help grow our team and earn rewards
- Company Bonus Scheme: Celebrate success with us.
- Enhanced Sick Pay: Supporting you when you need it most
- Enhanced Parental Leave: Comprehensive support for your family journey
- Salary Sacrifice Pension Scheme: Save for your future with ease.
- Life Assurance & Income Protection (UK Only): Peace of mind for you.
- HSF Health Plan: Access affordable healthcare.
- YuLife Wellbeing Platform: One stop shop for wellbeing, rewards and support.
- Employee Assistance Programme: Mental health support, virtual GP services and more.
- Lunch on Liquidline & Bi-Annual Conferences: Enjoy lunch on Liquidline, and Bi Annual company conferences.

Liquidline is a fast-growing, family owned business that has expanded from 92 to over 300 employees since 2020. With ambitious plans for the next five years, there's never been a better time to join us! Our dynamic and innovative environment offers endless opportunities for personal and professional growth.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer, treating everyone with fairness, respect and appreciation. At Liquidline, we embrace diversity and value the unique experiences and perspectives of every individual. Together, we are always Winning Together!

GBP (yearly)

title: Operations Co-ordinator
description:
Operations Co-ordinator
Lowestoft, Suffolk (Fully Site-Based)
6-Month Contract (until 20/03/2027)
Inside IR35: 17.00 per hour PAYE or 21.81 per hour Umbrella
Overtime: 150%

Belcan Workforce Solutions is recruiting for an Operations Co-ordinator to support a major offshore wind operations site in Lowestoft, Suffolk. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-paced renewable energy environment, playing a key role in ensuring the smooth coordination of maintenance activities, operational planning, and site administration. This position is fully site-based. Due to the operational requirements of the role, candidates should ideally be based within approximately 30 minutes of the Lowestoft site.

Working within a busy operational team, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate technical and commercial records, coordinating planned and reactive maintenance activities, and supporting site operations through SAP and associated systems. You will liaise closely with field personnel and operational stakeholders to optimise schedules, resource allocation, and Crew Transfer Vessel (CTV) deployment. The role also includes supporting reporting, parts consumption tracking, timesheet verification, billing processes, and ensuring all work is completed in line with HSE requirements and UK legislation.

The successful Operations Co-ordinator will be highly organised, detail-focused, and confident working with multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Strong Excel and general IT skills are essential, while SAP experience would be advantageous but is not required. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across teams are key to success in this role.

Key Requirements & Benefits
- Fully site-based role in Lowestoft, Suffolk
- 7 days on / 7 days off shift pattern working 12-hour days
- Initial 4-week training period worked Monday to Friday
- Competitive rates of 17.00 per hour PAYE or 21.81 per hour Umbrella, plus 150% overtime

Apply now for this Operations Co-ordinator opportunity and take the next step in your career within the renewable energy sector.

This vacancy is being advertised by Belcan

title: Administrator
description: We are seeking to recruit an enthusiastic and flexible Administrator, to join our fantastic team at Howard House Surgery in Felixstowe,with the primary focus on the role within Secretarial administration and prescriptions administration supporting with referrals and prescription requests. We are part of Suffolk Primary Care, which is a group of GP practices delivering patient care across Suffolk. The vacancy is for 3 days a week; however, this may be negotiable for the right candidate. Flexibility is crucial to accommodate training, holidays and occasional sickness. Howard House Surgery supports in excess of 8500 patients from a diverse range of backgrounds. We have an established team with a strong focus on customer service and on developing staff in order to deliver excellent standards of patient care. We use SystmOne and askmyGP to facilitate effective and efficient ways of working. You should be able to work calmly and professionally as part of a team, with the ability to multi-task. A strong command of written and spoken English with an excellent telephone manner is a must. Good time management skills and the ability to follow protocols and or instruction and attention to detail is essential. We offer a competitive salary along with other employee benefits, and the opportunity to join the NHS pension scheme. The main responsibilities of the post holder will be to ensure timely, accurate and consistent completions of referrals to secondary care, as well as accurately completing prescription requests and sending these to the appropriate pharmacy's. Working as part of a team, the post holder will be responsible for working closely with clinicians to gain the appropriate information to complete referrals and ensuring repeat medications are kept up to date and safely prescribed. They are accountable to the Administration Lead and Practice Operations Manager. Patient Administration Appointment management Results filing OOH and 111 reports filing and actions SystmOne tasks Online consultation tasks and associated actions Managing clinical correspondence, scanning & document management Shared email inboxes Care home administration Notes summarising Long term condition management Patient recalls Vaccine clinic administration Other clinic administration (LARC, minor surgery etc.) Prescription management Interpreting service bookings Medical Records Administration Patient registrations New patient checks Deduction requests Arrival of notes GP2GP transfers Sending of notes Deceased patient administration Clinical Correspondence & Reports Referrals (DXS) Medical reports, insurance requests Subject access requests Practice Administration Procurement and stock ordering Facilities and premises administration Meeting support and minute taking Rota support and locum booking administration CQC compliance and audit support Enhanced services and contractual claims and reporting
